newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai PM appoints more economic advisers.
newsitem.headline: Thai PM appoints more economic advisers.

text.p: Thai Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh appointed former premier Chatichai Choonhavan head of the premier's economic and foreign affairs advisory team, officials said on Thursday.
Chatichai is leader of the Chart Pattana Party, one of the six parties in Chavalit's ruling coalition which assumed power in early December after elections in mid-November.
Other members of the team are:

Former finance minister Surakiart Sathirathai, former foreign minister Kasem S. Kasemsri, Chalongphob Sussangkarn, president of the private-run Thailand Development Research Institute, Pridiyathorn Devakula, president of Export and Import Bank of Thailand, and Pin Chakkaphak, president of Finance One Plc.
Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan has been named the head of economic affairs in the Chavalit government. He also has a team of advisers.
